def: to rear up to maturity, i.e. (genitive case) to cherish or train

occurrences.text: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:
And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
